a: Hen teheve archa lishlevtach", uchetiv: "kolla meta al nevuchadnetztzar malka", uchetiv: "liktzat yarchin tere asar"!
Leolam rabbi yishmael, veashkach kera deamar vetane, dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe edom",
Umay af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar? dilma shane goyim, dela mippekid dina alayyhu.
Veyesh zechut tola shalosh shanim kulei. zechut demay? illema zechut detora — ha enah metzuvva veosa hi! ella zechut demitzva.

Zechut demitzva mi maggena kulle hay? vehatanya: et zo darash rabbi menachem bar yose: "ki ner mitzva vetora or", tala hakkatuv et hammitzva bener, veet hattora beor. et hammitzva bener, lomar lach: ma ner enah meginna ella lefi shaa — af mitzva enah meginna ella lefi shaa.

Veet hattora beor, lomar lach: ma or megen laolam, af tora meginna laolam. veomer: "behithallechcha tanche otach vegomer". "behithallechcha tanche otach" — ze haolam hazze. "beshachbecha tishmor alecha" — zo mita. "vahakitzota hi tesichecha" — leatid lavo.
Mashal leadam shehaya mehallech beishon layla vaafela, umityayre min hakkotzim umin happechatim umin habbarkanim, umechayya raa umin hallistin, veeno yodea beeze derech mehallech.

Nizdammena lo avuka shel ur — nitztzal min hakkotzim umin happechatim umin habbarkanim, vaadayin mityayre mechayya raa umin hallistin, veeno yodea beeze derech mehallech. kevan sheala ammud hashshachar — nitztzal mechayya raa umin hallistin, vaadayin eno yodea beeze derech mehallech. higgia lefarashat derachim — nitztzal mikkullam.
Davar acher: avera mechabba mitzva, veen avera mechabba tora, shenneemar: "mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava".

Amar rav yosef: mitzva, beiddana deasek bah — maggena umatztzela, beiddana dela asek bah — aggone maggena, atztzole la matztzela. tora, ben beiddana deasek bah uven beiddana dela asek bah — maggena umatztzela.

Matkef la rabba: ella meatta, doeg vaachitofel mi la aski betora? ammay la hegenna alayyhu? ella amar rava: tora beiddana deasek bah — maggena umatztzela, beiddana dela asek bah — aggone maggena, atztzole la matztzela. mitzva, ben beiddana deasek bah ben beiddana dela asek bah — aggone maggena, atztzole la matztzela.

Ravina amar: leolam zechut tora, udekaamrat enah metzuvva veosa nehi dippakkode la mippakkeda, beagra demakreyan umatneyayn benayyhu venatran lehu legavrayyhu ad deatu mibbe midresha, mi la palgan bahadayyhu?

May parashat derachim? amar rav chisda: ze talmid chacham veyom mita. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ze talmid chacham veyirat chet. mar zutera amar: ze talmid chacham desalka leh shematata allibba dehilcheta.

Davar acher: avera mechabba mitzva, veen avera mechabba tora. amar rav yosef: darsheh rabbi menachem bar yose lehay kera ki sinay, veilmale darshu doeg vaachitofel hachi la redafu batar david, dichtiv: "lemor elohim azavo vegomer".
May derush — "velo yire vecha ervat davar vegomer", vehen enan yodin sheavera mechabba mitzva, veen avera mechabba tora.
May "boz yavuzu lo"? amar ulla: la keshimon achi azarya, vela kerabbi yochanan deve nesia,

Ella kehillel veshevna. dechi ata rav dimi, amar: hillel veshevna ache havo. hillel asak battora, shevna avad iska. lesof, amar leh: ta naarov veliflog! yatzta bat kol veamra: "im yitten ish et kol hon beto vegomer".
b: Omer ben azzay: chayyayv adam lelammed et vechulei. rabbi eliezer omer: kol hamelammed et bitto tora — melammedah tiflut. tiflut salka datach? ella ema: keillu limmedah tiflut.
Amar rabbi avahu: may tama derabbi eliezer, dichtiv: "ani chochma shachanti orma", kevan shennichnesa chochma beadam — nichnesa immo armumit.

Verabbanan, hay "ani chochma" may avdi leh? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina. deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: en divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmaamid atzmo arom alehen, shenneemar: "ani chochma shachanti orma". amar rabbi yochanan: en divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmesim atzmo kemi sheeno, shenneemar: "vehachochma meayin timmatze".
Rabbi yehoshua omer: rotza ishsha vechulei. may kaamar? hachi kaamar: rotza ishsha bekav vetiflut immo, mittishat kabbin uferishut.
Hu haya omer: chasid shote kulei. hechi dame chasid shote? kegon deka tava itteta benahara, veamar: lav orach ara leistakkole ba veatztzola.

Hechi dame rasha arum? amar rabbi yochanan: ze hammatim devarav laddayyayn kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. rabbi avahu omer: ze hannoten dinar leani lehashelim lo matayim zuz. ditnan: mi sheyyesh lo matayim zuz — lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. haya lo matayim chaser dinar, afillu elef notnin lo keachat — hare ze yittol.
Rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim muatin. deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: yetomim shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin — ma shemmachru machru.

Abbaye amar: ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel. detanya: "nechasay lecha, veacharecha lifloni", veyarad harishon umachar veachal — hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon.
Rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet: ze hammachria acherim beorchotav. rabbi zerika amar rav huna: ze hammekel leatzmo umachmir laacherim. ulla amar: ze

a: Shekkara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim.
Ittemar: kara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim, rabbi elazar omer: hare ze am haaretz. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: hare ze bur. rabbi yannay omer: hare ze kuti.
Rav acha bar yaakov omer: hare ze magosh. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera kerav acha bar yaakov, deamri inashe: raten magosha vela yada may amar, tane tanna vela yada may amar.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu am haaretz? kol sheeno kore keriat shema shacharit vearvit bevirchoteha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol sheeno manniach tefillin. ben azzay omer: kol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo. rabbi yonatan ben yosef amar: kol sheyyesh lo banim veeno megaddelan lilmod tora. acherim omrim: afillu kore veshone velo shimmesh talmide chachamim — zehu am haaretz.
Kara velo shana — hare ze bur, lo kara velo shana — alav hakkatuv omer: "vezarati et bet yisrael veet bet yehuda zera adam vezera behema".

"Yera et Adonai beni vamelech im shonim al titarav", amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu sheshshonim halachot. peshita! mahu detema — shonin bechet, vechidrav huna. deamar rav huna: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah — huttera lo, ka mashma lan.

Tana: hattannaim — mevalle olam. mevalle olam salka datach?! amar ravina: shemmorin halacha mittoch mishnatan. tanya name hachi, amar rabbi yehoshua: vechi mevalle olam hen? vahalo meyayshsheve olam hen, shenneemar: "halichot olam lo"! ella, shemmorin halacha mittoch mishnatan.
Ishsha perusha vechulei. tanu rabbanan: betula tzalyaynit, vealmana shovavit, vekatan shello kalu lo chodashav — hare ellu mevalle olam.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: lamadnu yirat chet mibbetula, vekibbul sachar mealmana. yirat chet mibbetula — derabbi yochanan shama lehahi betula denafla aappa vekaamra: ribbono shel olam, barata gan eden uvarata gehinnam, barata tzaddikim uvarata reshaim. yehi ratzon millefanecha shello yikkashlu bi bene adam.

Kibbul sachar mealmana — dehahi almana dahavay be chenishta beshivavuta. kol yoma havat atya umetzalla be midresheh derabbi yochanan. amar la: bitti, lo bet hakkeneset beshivavutich? amara leh: rabbi, velo sechar pesiot yesh li?
Ki kaamar, kegon yochani bat retivi.
May "katan shello kalu lo chodashav"? hacha targimu: ze talmid chacham hamevaet berabbotav.

Rabbi abba amar: ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore. deamar rabbi avahu amar rav huna amar rav: may dichtiv "ki rabbim chalalim hippila vaatzumim kol harugeha". "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" — ze talmid chacham shello higgia lehoraa umore. "vaatzumim kol harugeha" — ze talmid chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more.
b: Vead kamma — ad arbein shenin. ini? veha rabba ori! beshavin.
Umakkot perushin vechulei. tanu rabbanan, shiva perushin hen: parush shichmi, parush nikpi, parush kizzay, parush meducheya, parush "ma chovati veeesenna", parush meahava, parush miyyira.

Parush shichmi — ze haose maase shechem. parush nikpi — ze hamenakkef et raglav. parush kizzay — amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ze hammakkiz dam lakketalim. parush meducheya — amar rabba bar shela: dimshappa ki meducheya.
Parush "ma chovati veeesenna". ha mealleyuta hi! ella deamar "ma chovati tu veeesenna".

Parush meahava, parush miyyira. amaru leh abbaye verava letanna: la tittene parush meahava parush miyyira, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam battora uvemitzvot afillu shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: demittammera mittammera, udemiggalleya miggalleya, be dina rabba litpera mehane dechafu gunede. amar la yannay malka lidveteh: al tityari min happerushin, velo mimmi sheenan perushin, ella min hatztzevuin sheddomin lifrushin, shemmaasehen kemaase zimri umevakkeshin sachar kefinchas.

Mishna rabbi shimon omer: en zechut tola bemayim hammarim. veim atta omer hazzechut tola bammayim hamearrin — madhe atta et hammayim bifne kol hannashim hashshotot. umotzi atta shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu, sheomrim: temeot hen, ella shettalta lahen zechut. rabbi omer: hazzechut tola bemayim hamearrim, veenah yoledet veenah mashbachat, ella mitnavvevna veholechet, lesof hi meta beotah mita.
Nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha bichli — hare hi kechol hammenachot, vetippade. veim mishshekkadsha bichli — hare hi kechol hammenachot, vetissaref. veellu shemminchotehen nisrafot:

a: Haomeret "temea ani lach", veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret "eni shota", veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha badderech,
Vechol hannesuot lechohanim — minchotehen nisrafot. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen — minchatah nisrefet, vechohenet shennisset leyisrael — minchatah neechelet.
Ma ben kohen lechohenet? minchat kohenet neechelet, uminchat kohen enah neechelet. kohenet mitchallelet, vechohen en mitchallel.
Kohenet mittammea lemetim, veen kohen mittamme lemetim. kohen ochel bekodshe kadashim, veen kohenet ochelet bekodshe kodashim.

Ma ben ish leishsha: haish porea uforem, veen haishsha poraat uforemet. haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet benah benazir. haish megalleach al nezirut aviv, veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha.

Haish mekaddesh et bitto, veen haishsha mekaddeshet et bittah. haish mocher et bitto, veen haishsha mocheret et bittah. haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma. haish nitle, veen haishsha nitlet. haish nimkar bignevato, veen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol hannesuot lakkehunna minchotehen nisrafot. ketzad? kohenet leviyya veyisreelit shennisset lechohen — en minchatah neechelet, mippene sheyyesh lo chelek bah. veenah ola kalil — mippene sheyyesh lah chelek bah. ella — hakkometz karev beatzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman.

Ikkeri kan: kol shehu mimmennu laishshim — hare hu beval taktiru"! amar yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: demassek lehu leshum etzim, kerabbi eliezer. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: lereach nichoach i atta maale, aval atta maalehu leshum etzim.

Hanicha lerabbi eliezer deit leh hay sevara, ella lerabbanan delet lehu hay sevara, may ikka lememar? deavdi lehu kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: hakkometz karev beatzmo, vehashshirayim mitpazzerim al bet haddeshen.
b: Vaafillu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ella beminchat chote shel kohanim, devat hakerava hi. aval beha, afillu rabbanan modu.
Bat yisrael hannesua vechulei. may tama — deamar kera: "vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel". kohen velo kohenet.
Kohenet mitchallelet, kohen en mitchallel. menalan — deamar kera: "velo yechallel zaro beammav". zaro mitchallel, vehu eno mitchallel.
Kohenet mittammea kulei. may tama — amar kera: "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon". bene aharon velo benot aharon.
Kohen ochel bekodshe kodashim, dichtiv: "kol zachar bivne aharon yochalenna".
Uma ben ish kulei. tanu rabbanan: "ish" — en li ella ish. ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer "vehatztzarua asher bo" — hare kan shenayim,
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "ish" — lainyan shellematta, ish porea vechulei.

Haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet benah benazir. amar rabbi yochanan, halacha hi benazir: haish megalleach al nezirut aviv, veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. amar rabbi yochanan: halacha hi benazir.

Haish mekaddesh et bitto, veen haishsha mekaddeshet et bittah — dichtiv: "et bitti natatti laish hazze". haish mocher et bitto, veen haishsha mocheret et bittah — dichtiv: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto".
Haish niskal arom kulei. may tama — "veragmu oto". may "oto"? illema oto velo otah, vehachtiv "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi"! ella: oto belo kesuto, velo otah belo kesutah.
Haish nitle veen kulei. may tama — amar kera: "vetalita oto al etz", oto velo otah.
Haish nimkar bignevato, veen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah. may tama, amar kera: "venimkar bignevato", bignevato velo bignevatah.
Hadaran alach haya notel
Arusa veshomeret yavam — lo shotot velo notlot ketuva, shenneemar: "asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah", perat laarusa veshomeret yavam.
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret

a: Unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin — lo shotot velo notlot ketuva.
Veellu lo shotot velo notlot ketuva: haomeret "temea ani", veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret "eni shota".
Amar balah "eni mashkah", veshebbalah ba aleha badderech — notlot ketubba velo shotot.
Metu balehen ad shello shatu, bet shammay omrim: notlot ketubba velo shotot, uvet hillel omrim: o shotot o lo notlot ketubbatan.
Meubberet chavero umenikat chavero — lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yachol hu lehaferishah ulehachzirah leachar zeman.
Ayylonit uzekena, vesheenah reuya leled — lo notlot ketubba velo shotot. rabbi elazar omer: yachol hu lissa ishsha acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna.
Ushear kol hannashim — o shotot o lo notlot ketubba. eshet kohen shota — umutteret levalah. eshet saris shota.
Al yede kol arayot mekannin, chutz min hakkatan umimmi sheeno ish.

Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen: mi shennitcharesh balah, o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. lo lehashekotah amru, ella lefoslah mikketubbatah. rabbi yose omer: af lehashekotah. lichsheyyetze balah mibbet haasurin yashkenna.
Gemara mishta hu dela shatyay, ha kannoye[10] mekanne la: mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "dabber el bene yisrael veamarta" — lerabbot arusa veshomeret yavam lekinnuy.
Umatnitin manni — rabbi yonatan hi. detanya: "tachat ishech", perat laarusa. yachol sheani motzi af shomeret yavam, talmud lomar: "ish ish", divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: "tachat ishech" — perat leshomeret yavam. otzi shomeret yavam velo otzi et arusa, talmud lomar: "asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah" — perat laarusa.
Mar allima leh arusa, dekiddushe dideh, vesoklin al yado.
Umar allima leh shomeret yavam, dela meychassera mesira lechuppa.
Verabbi yonatan, hay "ish ish" may aved leh? mibbee leh lerabbot eshet cheresh, veeshet shote, veeshet
b: Shaamum. verabbi yoshiyya, hay "tachat ishah" may aved leh? mibbee leh lehakkish ish leishsha veishsha leish.

Ella, tama dichtivi hane kerae, ha lav hachi, hava amena arusa shatya? veha ki ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma, ata veayyti matnita bideh: "mibbalade ishech", mishshekkadma shechivat baal labboel, velo shekkadma shechivat boel labbaal.
Amar rame bar chama: mashkachat la — kegon shebba aleha arus bevet aviha.
Dichvota gabbe shomeret yavam — kegon shebba aleha yavam bevet chamiha. ha shomeret yavam karet la? ishto meallayyta hi, dehaamar rav: kana lakkol!
Kishmuel, deamar: lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha.
I hachi, lema rav deamar kerabbi yoshiyya ushemuel deamar kerabbi yonatan? amar lach rav: ana daamari — afillu lerabbi yonatan. middeitzterich kera lemaota — mikkelal deishto meallayyta hi.

a: Ushemuel amar: ana daamari — afillu lerabbi yoshiyya. middeitzterich kera lerabboya — mikkelal delav ishto hi kelal.
Ibbaya lehu: overet al dat tzericha hateraa lehafesidah ketubbatah, o enah tzericha? mi amrinan: kevan deoveret al dat hi — la baaya hateraa, o dilma tive hateraa, dei hadra ba tihdar ba?
Ta shema: arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketuva. mishta hu dela shatya, ha kannoye mekanne la. lemay? lav lehafesidah ketubbatah?
Amar abbaye: la, leosrah alav. rav pappa amar: lehashekotah keshehi nesua. kidtanya: en mekannin laarusa lehashekotah keshehi arusa, aval mekannin laarusa lehashekotah keshehi nesua.
Amar rava, ta shema: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin — lo shotot velo notlot ketuva.
Mishta hu dela shatya, ha kannoye mekanne lehu. ulemay? i leosran alav — ha asiran vekayyman, ella lav: lehafesidan ketubbatan?
Amar rav yehuda middiskarta: la, leosrah labboel kabbaal. ditnan: keshem sheasura labbaal — kach asura labboel.

Amar rav chanina missura: ta shema, veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen: mi shennitcharesh balah, o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. velo lehashekotah amru, ella lefoslah mikketubbatah. shema minna bae hateraa. shema minna.
Vechullehu, may tama la amri meha! dilma shane hatam, delet la emta devaal kelal.
Ibbaya lehu: overet al dat veratza baal lekayyeymah, mekayyeymah o eno mekayyeymah? mi amrinan bikfida devaal tela rachamana, veha la kafed. o dilma kevan dekafed — kafed?

Ta shema, veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen: mi shennitcharesh balah, o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. vei amrat ratza baal lekayyeymah mekayyeymah, avdi bet din midde dedilma la nicha leh levaal? setama demilleta: kevan deoveret al dat hi — menach nicha leh.

Ibbaya lehu: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, o eno machul? mi amrinan bekinnuy devaal tela rachamana, uvaal ha machel leh lekinnuyo, o dilma: kevan dekanni lay meikkara — la matze machel leh?

Ta shema, veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen: mi shennitcharesh balah, o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. vei amrat baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, avdinan midde deate baal machel leh? setama demilleta, adam maskim al daat bet din.
Ta shema: umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. vei amrat baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, lachleh lekinnuye velivol!
May shena talmide chachamim — digmiri, dei bae lemival, amri leh: achaleh lekinnuyaych uvala.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi yoshiyya: shelosha devarim sach li zeera meanshe yerushalayim: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, vezaken mamre sheratzu bet din limchol lo — mochalin lo, uven sorer umore sheratzu aviv veimmo limchol lo — mochalin lo.
Ucheshebbati etzel chaveray shebbaddarom, al shenayim hodu li, veal zaken mamre lo hodu li — shello yirbu machalokot beyisrael. shema minna: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul. shema minna.
Peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: kodem setira — machul, leachar setira — eno machul. vechad amar: leachar setira, name machul. umistabbera keman deamar eno machul,
Mimmay — middeka mehadderi rabbanan lerabbi yose. detanya, rabbi yose omer: balah neeman aleha, mikkal vachomer: uma nidda shehi becharet — balah neeman aleha, sota shehi belav, lo — kol shekken?
Amru lo: lo, im amarta benidda — shekken yesh lah hetter, tomar besota — sheen lah hetter.
Vei amrat leachar setira machul lah, mashkachat la deyesh lah hetter, dei bae machel leh lekinnuye uvael. ella shema minna: leachar setira eno machul. shema minna.
Metu balehen ad shello shatu, bet shammay kulei. bemay kamippalgi? bet shammay savri: shetar haomed ligbot — kegavuy dame.
b: Uvet hillel savri: shetar haomed ligbot — lav kegavuy dame.
Meubberet chavero kulei. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: machloket baakara uzekena.
Aval ayylonit — divre hakkol lo shota velo notelet ketubbatah, shenneemar: "venikketa venizrea zara", mi sheddarkah lehazeria, yatza zo sheen darkah lehazeria.
Metivi: hamekanne laarusato uleshomeret yavam shello, im ad shello kenasah nistera — lo shota velo notelet ketubbatah.

a: Meubberet chavero umeneket chavero — lo shotot velo notlot ketuva, divre rabbi meir.
Shehaya rabbi meir omer: lo yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero, veim nasa — yotzi velo yachzir olamit. vachachamim omrim: yotzi, uchesheyyaggia zemanno lichnos — yichnos.
Veharove shennasa akara uzekena, veen lo ishsha uvanim meikkara — lo shota velo notelet ketubba. rabbi elazar omer: yachol hu lissa acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna.

Aval hamekanne laarusato uleshomeret yavam shello, umishshekkenasah nistera — o shota, o lo notelet ketubba. meubberet umeneket atzmo — o shota, o lo notelet ketubbatah. harove shennasa akara uzekena, veyesh lo ishsha uvanim — o shota, o lo notelet ketubba.
Eshet mamzer lemamzer, veeshet natin lenatin, veeshet ger veeved meshucherar, veayylonit — o shota, o lo notelet ketubba. katane miha ayylonit, teyuveteh derav nachman!

Amar lecha rav nachman: tannae hi, vaana daamari ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ayylonit — lo shota velo notelet ketubba, shenneemar: "venikketa venizrea zara" — mi sheddarkah lehazeria. yatzata zo — sheen darkah lehazeria.

Verabbanan, hay "venikketa venizrea zara" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "venikketa venizrea [zara]", sheim hayta akara nifkedet, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yishmael: im ken, yissatru kol haakarot veyippakdu, vezo, hoil velo nistera hifsida?!
Im ken, ma talmud lomar: "venikketa venizrea zara", sheim hayta yoledet betzaar — yoledet berevach, nekevot — yoledet zecharim, ketzarim — yoledet arukkim, shechorim — yoledet levanim.
Eshet mamzer lemamzer. peshita! mahu detema: apposhe pesulin la laypesh, ka mashma lan.
Eshet ger veeved meshucherar veayylonit. peshita?
Mahu detema: "dabber el bene yisrael", velo gerim, ka mashma lan. veema hachi name! "veamarta" — ribbuya hu.
Eshet kohen shota kulei. eshet kohen shota — peshita! mahu detema: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret. vezo, hoil venitpasa asura — ema la tishte, ka mashma lan.
Umutteret levalah. peshita! amar rav huna: bemitnavvevna. mitnavvevna — ha badkuha mayya!
Bemitnavvevna derech evarim. mahu detema: ha zannoye zannay, veha dela badkuha mayya ki orchay[u] — mishshum divones zannay, ulegabbe kohen asira, ka mashma lan.
Eshet saris shota. peshita! mahu detema: "mibbalade ishech" amar rachamana, vehay lav bar hachi hu, ka mashma lan.
Al yede kol arayot mekannin. peshita!
b: Mahu detema: "nitmaa" "nitmaa" shene peamim: echad labbaal veechad labboel. hecha deka mittasra beha zenut, aval ha hoil vaasura vekayyma, ema la, ka mashma lan.
Chutz min hakkatan vechulei. "ish" amar rachamana, velo katan vesheeno ish. lemaote may? illema lemaote shachuf, vehaamar shemuel: shachuf mekannin al yado, ufosel bitruma!
Mekannin al yado, peshita! mahu detema: "veshachav ish otah shichvat zera" amar rachamana, veha lav bar hachi hu, ka mashma lan.
Ufosel bitruma. peshita! mahu detema: "lo yechallel zaro" amar rachamana: deit leh zera — lichallel, delet leh zera — la lichallel, ka mashma lan.
Veella lemaote nochri? vehaamar rav hamenuna: nochri mekannin al yado ufosel bitruma.
Mekannin al yado — peshita! mahu detema "nitmaa" "nitmaa" shete peamim: echad labbaal veechad labboel, hecha dekamittasra beha zenut, aval ha hoil vaasira vekayyma, ema la, kamashma lan.
Ufosel bitruma — peshita! mahu detema: "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar" amar rachamana: devar havaya — in, delav bar havaya — la, kamashma lan defasel midderabbi yochanan,

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: minnayin lenochri veeved shebbau al hakkohenet veal halleviyyay veal bat yisrael, sheppesaluha — shenneemar: "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha". mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah, yatzu nochri veeved, sheen lo almenut vegerushin bah.
Veella lemaote may? amar rav pappa: lemaote behema, deen zenut bivhema.
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan en zenut bivhema, dichtiv: "lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev vegomer".
Vetanya: etnan kelev umechir zona — muttarin, shenneemar: "gam shenehem", shenayim velo arbaa.
Veella "shichvat zera", lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "shichvat zera" — perat ledavar acher.
May "davar acher"? amar rav sheshet: perat leshekkinne lah shello kedarkah. amar leh rava: shello kedarkah, "mishkeve ishsha" ketiv!
Ella amar rava: perat leshekkinne lah derech evarim. amar leh abbaye: peritzuta bealma hi, uferitzuta mi asar rachamana.

Ella amar abbaye: perat leshekkinne lah binshika. hanicha leman deamar haaraa zo hachenasat atara, aval neshika — velo kelum hi, hayeynu deate kera lemaote neshika. ella leman deamar haaraa zo neshika, may ikka lememar?
Leolam — leshekkinne lah derech evarim. umahu detema bikfida devaal talya rachamana, uvaal ha ka kafed, kamashma lan.
Amar shemuel: yissa adam

a: Duma, veal yissa bat duma. shezzo baa mittippa keshera, vezo baa mittippa pesula.
Verabbi yochanan amar: yissa adam bat duma, veal yissa duma. shezzo omedet bechezkat kashrut, vezo enah omedet bechezkat kashrut.
Metivi: nose adam duma! amar rava: vetisbera nose lechattechilla?! ella: im nasa, teni name: "bat duma".
Vehilcheta: yissa adam bat duma, veal yissa duma. detane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: ishsha mezanna — baneha kesherin, rov beilot achar habbaal.
Bae rav amram: hayta perutza beyoter, mahu? allibba deman deamar en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch levivstah — la tibbee lach, dela yada ba vela menattar la.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba deman deamar en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch litvilatah, may? kevan deyada bah, nattore menattar lah, o dilma kevan difrutza beyoter — la? teku.

Veellu shebbet din kulei. tanu rabbanan: "ish", ma talmud lomar "ish ish" — lerabbot eshet cheresh, veeshet shote, veeshet shaamum, veshehalach balah limdinat hayyam, veshehaya chavush bevet haasurin — shebbet din mekannin lahen lefoslan mikketubbatan.
Yachol af lehashekotan — talmud lomar: "vehevi haish et ishto". rabbi yose omer: af lehashekotah, velichsheyyetze balah mibbet haasurin yashkenna.
Bemay ka mippalgi, rabbanan savri: baenan "vekinne ... vehevi", verabbi yose savar: la baenan "vekinne ... vehevi".

Tanu rabbanan: "asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah", lehakkish ish leishsha veishsha leish. lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: keshem sheim hu some lo haya mashkah, dichtiv: "venelam meene ishah", kach hi, im hayta soma — lo hayta shota. rav ashe amar: keshem shechiggeret vegiddemet lo hayta shota, dichtiv:
b: "Veheemid hakkohen et haishsha lifne Adonai ... venatan al kappeha" — kach hu — im haya chigger o giddem, lo haya mashkah. mar bar rav ashe amar: keshem sheillemet lo hayta shota, dichtiv: "veamra haishsha amen amen", kach hu — im haya illem, lo haya mashkah.
Hadaran alach arusa
Keshem shehammayim bodkin otah, kach hammayim bodkin oto, shenneemar: "uvau" "uvau".
Keshem sheasura labbaal — kach asura labboel, shenneemar: "nitmaa" "venitmaa", divre rabbi akiva.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: kach haya doresh zecharya ben hakkatztzav, rabbi omer: shene peamim haamurim bapparasha "nitmaa" "venitmaa" — echad labbaal veechad labboel.
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva: "ucheli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma", eno omer "tame" ella "yitma", letamme acherim. limmed al kikkar sheni shemmetamme et hashshelishi.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: mi yegalle afar meenecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita omer: atid dor acher letaher kikkar shelishi, sheen lo mikra min hattora shehu tame, vahalo rabbi akiva talmidcha mevi lo mikra min hattora shehu tame, shenneemar: "kol asher betocho yitma".
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva: "umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer", umikra acher omer: "mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv".
I efshar lomar elef amma, shekkevar neemar alpayim amma. vei efshar lomar alpayim amma, shekkevar neemar elef amma. ha ketzad? elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma techum hashshabbat.
Rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma sadot ucheramim.

Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva: "az yashir moshe uvene yisrael et hashshira hazzot laAdonai vayyomru lemor", sheen talmud lomar "lemor", uma talmud lomar "lemor"? melammed shehayu yisrael onin shira acharav shel moshe al kol davar vedavar kekorin et [ha]hallel: ("ashira laAdonai ki gao gaa".) lechach neemar "lemor".
Rabbi nechemya omer: kekorin et shema, velo kekorin et [ha]hallel.

Bo bayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hurekanos: lo avad iyyov et hakkadosh baruch hu ella meahava, shenneemar: "hen yikteleni lo ayachel". vaadayin haddavar shakul: lo ani metzappe, o eni metzappe — talmud lomar: "ad egva lo asir tummati mimmenni", melammed shemmeahava asa.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: mi yegalle afar meenecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita doresh kol yamecha shello avad iyyov et hammakom ella miyyira, shenneemar: "ish tam veyashar yere elohim vesar mera", vahalo yehoshua talmid talmidcha limmed shemmeahava asa.
Gemara "oto" leman? ilema levaal — baal may aved? vechi tema

a: Dei it beh avon badki leh mayya, ki it beh avon bedideh mi badki la mayya ledida? veha tanya: "venikka haish meavon vehaishsha hahi tissa et avonah". bizman shehaish menukke meavon — hammayim bodkin et ishto, en haish menukke meavon — en hammayim bodkin et ishto!
Veella levoel, litne kidkatane sefa: keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel!
Leolam labboel, veresha — ayyeyde ditna "otah", tane "oto". sefa — ayyeyde ditna "baal", tena "boel".
Shenneemar: "uvau" "uvau". ibbaya lehu: "bau" "uvau" kaamar, o "uvau" "uvau" kaamar?
Ta shema: keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel, shenneemar: "nitmaa" "venitmaa".
Vaadayin tibbee: "nitmaa" "nitmaa" kaamar, o "nitmaa" "venitmaa" kaamar?
Ta shema middekatane sefa, rabbi omer: shene peamim haamurin bapparasha "venitmaa" "venitmaa" — echad labbaal veechad labboel. mikkelal derabbi akiva vave kadaresh.
Hilkach lerabbi akiva shitta kerae ketivi:
Chad letzavvaa dida, vechad letzavvaa dideh.
Chad laasiyyay dida, vechad laasiyyay dideh.
Chad lidia dida, vechad lidia dideh.
Verabbi, telata kerae ketivi: chad — letzavvaa, vechad — laasiyyay, vechad — lidia.
Verabbi, keshem shehammayim bodkin otah kach bodkin oto, mena leh?

Nafka leh middetanya: "latzbot beten velanpil yarech", bitno virecho shel boel. atta omer bitno virecho shel boel, o eno ella bitnah virechah shel nivelet? keshehu omer "vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah", hare bitnah virechah shel nivelet amur, uma ani mekayyem "latzbot beten velanpil yarech" — bitno virecho shel boel.
Veiddach, hahu demoda la kohen deveten beresha vahadar yarech, shello lehotzi laaz al hammayim hammarim.
Veiddach: im ken, lichtov kera "bitnah virechah", may "beten" veyarech"? shema minna levoel.
Veema (kulle) [kulleh] lehachi hu daata? im ken, lichtov "bitno" virecho". may "beten" veyarech"? shema minna tarte.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: kach haya doresh zecharya kulei.
Tanu rabbanan: shalosh peamim haamurin bapparasha "im nitmea", "nitmaa", "venitmaa", lamma? echad labbaal, veechad labboel, veechad litruma, divre rabbi akiva.
Amar rabbi yishmael, kal vachomer: uma gerusha shemmutteret litruma — asura lichhunna, zo sheasura bitruma — eno din sheasura lichhunna?
Ma talmud lomar "vehi nitmaa", "vehi lo nitmaa" — im nitmea lamma shota? im lo nitmea lamma mashkah? maggid lecha hakkatuv shehassafek asura.
Mikkan atta dan lesheretz: uma sota, shello asa bah shogeg kemezid veones keratzon — asa bah safek kevadday, sheretz, sheasa bo shogeg kemezid veones keratzon — eno din sheyyaase bo safek
b: Kevadday.
Umimmakom shebbata: ma sota reshut hayyachid — af sheretz reshut hayyachid.
Uma sota davar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael — af sheretz davar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael.
Umikkan amru: davar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael, birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame, birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor. vesheen bo daat lishshael, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor.
Verabbi yishmael: amar rabbi akiva teruma, umahdar leh ihu kehunna?
Vetu: lerabbi akiva, kehunna mena leh? vechi tema kehunna la tzericha kera,

a: Shehare asa bah sefek zona kezona. teruma name la tibbee kera, shehare asa bah sefek zona kezona!
Ella lerabbi akiva arbea kerae ketivi: chad levaal, vechad levoel, vechad lichhunna, vechad litruma.
Verabbi yishmael telata kerae ketivi: chad levaal, vechad levoel, vechad litruma, uchehunna atya bekal vachomer.
Verabbi yishmael, mimmay deitzterich kera litruma, uchehunna atya bekal vachomer? dilma ki itzterich lichhunna, uteruma sharya!
Amar lach: mistabbera dumeya devaal uvoel. ma baal uvoel mechayyim — af teruma name mechayyim, leappoke kehunna dilachar mita.
Verabbi akiva, dumeya devaal uvoel let leh.
Vei name it leh, milleta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatev la kera.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: davar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael veen bo daat lishshael mehay kera nafka: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel"; vadday tame hu delo yeachel, ha safek tame vesafek tahor — yeachel.
Ema sefa: "vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar"; vadday tahor hu deyochal basar, ha safek tame vesafek tahor — lo yochal.
Ella lav shema minna: kan sheyyesh bo daat lishshael, kan sheen bo daat lishshael.
Veitzterich derav giddel amar rav, veitzterich lemigmar missota. dei midderav, hava amena — ben birshut hayyachid uven birshut harabbim, itzterich lemigmar missota.
Vei missota, hava amena — ad deikka daat nogea umaggia, tzericha.
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva vechol keli cheres kulei.
Umeachar deen lo, lamma tame?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: min hattora en lo, middin kal vachomer yesh lo. uma tevul yom shemmuttar bechullin — posel bitruma, kikkar sheni sheppasul bechullin — eno din sheyyaase shelishi bitruma?
Ikka lemifrach: ma litvul yom shekken av hattumea!
Tete
b: Mittevul yom desheretz!
Ma litvul yom desheretz shekken bemino av hattumea!
Keli cheres yochiach.
Ma lichli cheres — shekken metamme meaviro!
Tevul yom yochiach.
Vechozer haddin. lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuttarin bechullin, ufoslin bitruma: kol shekken kikkar sheni shepposel bechullin — defosel bitruma.
Vedor acher parech: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen — shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur.
Verabban yochanan ben zakkay, tzad chamur la parech.
Tanya, amar rabbi yose: minnayin lirvii bakkodesh sheppasul?
Vedin hu: ma mechussar kippurim, shemmuttar batteruma — pasul bakkodesh. shelishi, sheppasul batteruma — eno din hu sheyyaase revii bakkodesh?
Velamadnu shelishi lakkodesh min hattora, urevii mikkal vachomer.
Shelishi lakkodesh min hattora menalan — dichtiv: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel". mi la askinan dinga besheni — veamar rachamana "lo yeachel". revii mikkal vachomer — kedaamaran.
Amar rabbi yochanan: taam beribbi eni yodea ma hu, shehare teshuvato betziddo: ochel habba mechamat tevul yom yochiach, sheppasul bitruma veeno ose revii bakkodesh.
Detanya, abba shaul omer: tevul yom techilla lakkodesh, letamme shenayim, velifsol echad.
Rabbi meir omer: metamme echad, ufosel echad. vachachamim omrim: keshem shepposel ochle teruma umashke teruma — kach posel ochle kodesh umashke kodesh!
Matkef la rav pappa: mimmay derabbi yose kerabbanan sevira leh? dilma keabba shaul sevira leh, deamar letamme shenayim velifsol echad!
I salka datach keabba shaul sevira leh, layyteh lirvii bakkodesh meochel shebba mechamat tevul yom.
Uma ochel habba mechamat tevul yom, ditvul yom gufeh muttar bechullin — amrat ose revii bakkodesh, ochel

a: Shelishi habba mechamat sheni, desheni gufeh asur bechullin — eno din sheose revii bakkodesh?
Vechi tema mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma litvul yom shekken av hattumea — ha ayytine mimmechussar kippurim, vela parcheh!
Amar rav assi amar rav, veamri la amar rabba ben isi amar rav: rabbi meir, verabbi yose, verabbi yehoshua, verabbi elazar, verabbi eliezer — kullehu sevira lehu deen sheni ose shelishi bechullin.
Rabbi meir — ditnan: kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim, metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim osrin bammaaser.
Rabbi yose — ha daamaran. deim iteh — layyteh lirvii batteruma, vachamishi bakkodesh.

Rabbi yehoshua — ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: haochel ochel rishon rishon, sheni — sheni, shelishi — shelishi. rabbi yehoshua omer: haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni — sheni, shelishi — sheni bakkodesh, veen sheni batteruma.
Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma.
Al tohorat hatteruma — in, al tohorat hakkodesh — la.
Alma kasavar: en sheni ose shelishi bechullin.
Rabbi elazar — detanya, rabbi elazar omer: shelashtan shavin, harishon shebbakkodesh veshebbachullin veshebbatteruma —
Metamme shenayim, ufosel echad bakkodesh,
Metamme echad, ufosel echad batteruma,
Ufosel echad bachullin.

Rabbi eliezer, ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: challa nittelet min hattehora al hattemea, ketzad? shete issot achat tehora veachat temea, notel kede challa meissa shello hurema challatah, venoten pachot mikkevetza baemtza kede littol min hammukkaf.
b: Vachachamim osrin.
Vetanya kevetza.
Savruha idde veidde beissa rishona, vechullin hattevulin lechalla la kechalla damu.
May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: en sheni ose shelishi bechullin,
Umar savar: sheni ose shelishi bechullin.
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: dechulle alma en sheni ose shelishi bechullin, vehacha bechullin hattevulin lechalla kamippalgi. mar savar: kechalla damu, umar savar: la kechalla damu.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma chullin hattevulin lechalla la kechalla damu, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin, vehacha bemuttar ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael kamippalgi.
Mar savar: muttar ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael, umar savar: asur ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael.
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva vechulei.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: techumin deorayyta, umar savar: derabbanan.

Tanu rabbanan, bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva: beshaa shealu yisrael min hayyam, natnu enehem lomar shira. vechetzad amru shira — kegadol hammakre et hallel, vehen onin acharav rashe ferakim. moshe amar "ashira laAdonai", vehen omrim "ashira laAdonai", moshe amar "ki gao gaa" vehen omrim "ashira laAdonai".

Rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: kekatan hammakre et hallel, vehen onin acharav kol ma shehu omer. moshe amar "ashira laAdonai" vehen omrim "ashira laAdonai", moshe amar "ki gao gaa", vehen omrim "ki gao gaa".
Rabbi nechemya omer: kesofer happores al shema bevet hakkeneset, shehu poteach techilla vehen onin acharav.
Bemay kamippalgi — rabbi akiva savar: "lemor", ammilleta kammayyta.
Verabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili savar: "lemor" — akkol milleta umilleta, verabbi nechemya savar: "vayyomru" — daamur kullehu bahade hadade, "lemor" — diftach moshe beresha.

Tanu rabbanan, darash rabbi yose haggelili: beshaa shealu yisrael min hayyam natnu enehem lomar shira. vechetzad amru shira — olal muttal al birke immo, vetinok yonek mishshede immo. kevan sherau et hashshechina, olal higbiah tzavvaro, vetinok shamat dad mippiv, veamru "ze eli veanvehu", shenneemar: "mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz".
Haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu ubbarim shebbime imman amru shira — shenneemar:

a: "Bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael".
Veha la chazo? amar rabbi tanchum: kares naasa lahen keaspaklarya hammeira verau.
Bo bayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hurekanos shello avad iyyov kulei. velichze hay "lo", i belamed alef ketiv — "lo" hu, i belamed vav ketiv — "lo" hu?
Vechol hecha dichtiv belamed alef, "lo" hu? ella meatta "bechol tzaratam lo tzar", dichtiv belamed alef, hachi name delo" hu?
Vechi tema hachi name, vehachtiv "umalach panav hoshiam"! ella lav, mashma hachi umashma hachi.
Tanya, rabbi meir omer: neemar "yere elohim" beiyyov, veneemar "yere elohim" beavraham, ma "yere elohim" haamur beavraham — meahava, af "yere elohim" haamur beiyyov — meahava.
Veavraham gufeh menalan — dichtiv "zera avraham ohavi".
May ikka ben ose meahava leose miyyira? ikka ha detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: gadol haose meahava yoter min haose miyyira, shezze taluy leelef dor. veze taluy lealpayim dor.
Hacha ketiv: "laalafim leohavay uleshomre mitzvotay", vehatam ketiv: "uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor".
Hatam name ketiv "leohavav uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor"!
Hay ledismich leh vehay ledismich leh.

Hanhu tere talmide dahavo yatvi kammeh derava, chad amar leh akreyun bechelmay: "ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha", vechad amar leh: akreyun bechelmay "veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha". amar lehu: tarvayychu rabbanan tzaddike gemure attun. mar meahava, umar miyyira.
Hadaran alach keshem shehammayim
Mi shekkinne leishto venistera, afillu shama meof happoreach — yotzi veyitten ketubba, divre rabbi eliezer.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: ad sheyyisu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana.
Amar ed echad "ani reitiha shennitmet" — lo hayta shota. velo od, ella afillu eved afillu shifcha — hare ellu neemanin af lefoslah mikketubbatah.
Chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah — hare ellu neemanot. velo lefoslah mikketubbatah, ella shello tishte.
Shehaya baddin: uma im edut rishona, sheen osartah issur olam — enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim, edut acharona, sheosartah issur olam — eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim?
Talmud lomar: "veed en bah", kol edut sheyyesh bah.
Vekal vachomer leedut harishona meatta: uma im
b: Edut acharona sheosartah issur olam — hare hi mitkayyemet beed echad, edut harishona sheen osartah issur olam — eno din shettitkayyem beed echad?
Talmud lomar: "ki matza vah ervat davar", ulehallan hu omer: "al pi shene edim ... yakum davar", ma lehallan al pi shenayim — af kan pi shenayim.
Ed omer "nitmet" veed omer "lo nitmet", ishsha omeret "nitmet" veishsha omeret "lo nitmet" — hayta shota.
Echad omer "nitmet" ushenayim omrim "lo nitmet" — hayta shota. shenayim omrim "nitmet" veechad omer "lo nitmet" — lo hayta shota.
Gemara hay talmud lomar "ki matza vah ervat davar",
Talmud lomar "bah" — bah velo bekinnuy, bah velo bistira mibbee leh!
Hachi name kaamar: talmud lomar "bah" — bah velo bekinnuy, bah velo bistira.
Vetumea bealma belo kinnuy uvelo setira, dela meheman ed echad menalan? neemar kan "davar", veneemar lehallan "davar". ma lehallan bishne edim — af kan bishne edim.
Ed omer nitmet. tama deka machchesh leh, ha la ka machchesh leh — ed echad meheman,
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "veed en bah" — bishnayim hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer bishnayim, o eno ella beechad — talmud lomar: "lo yakum ed echad beish vegomer".
Mimmashma shenneemar "lo yakum ed", eni yodea shehu echad, ma talmud lomar "echad" — ze bana av: kol makom shenneemar "ed" — hare kan shenayim, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "echad".
Veamar rachamana: tere let ba ella chad, "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura.
Vechevan demiddeorayyta ed echad meheman, iddach hechi matze machchesh leh? veha amar ulla: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad, hare kan shenayim, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim!
Ella amar ulla, teni: lo hayta shota. vechen amar rabbi yitzchak: lo hayta shota. verabbi chiyyay amar: hayta shota.
Lerabbi chiyyay kashya deulla. la kashya: kan bevat achat. kan beze achar ze.
Tenan: ed omer "nitmet" ushenayim omrim "lo nitmet" — hayta shota. ha chad vechad — lo hayta shota, teyuveta derabbi chiyyay!
Amar lach rabbi chiyyay: velitamaych, ema sefa: shenayim omrim "nitmet" veechad omer "lo nitmet" — lo hayta shota. ha chad vechad — hayta shota.
Ella, kulla bifsule edut, verabbi nechemya hi. detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad.
Veikka deamri: kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikkara — afillu mea nashim name keed echad damyayn.

a: Vehacha bemay askinan — kegon daatay ishsha meikkara.

Vetartza lidrabbi nechemya hachi, rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beishsha achat kishne anashim beish echad. aval shete nashim beish echad — ki palga ufalga dame.
Vetarte bifsule edut lema li? mahu detema: ki azlinan batar rov deot lechumera, aval lekulla la azlinan, ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach mi shekkinne
Ellu neemarin bechol lashon: parashat sota, uvidduy maaser, keriyyat shema, utefilla, uvirkat hammazon, ushevuat haedut, ushevuat happikkadon.

Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh: mikra bikkurim, vachalitza, berachot ukelalot, birkat kohanim, uvirkat kohen gadol, ufarashat hammelech, ufarashat egla arufa, umeshuach milchama beshaa shemmedabber el haam.
Mikra bikkurim ketzad? "veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha", ulehallan hu omer: "veanu haleviyyim veamru". ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Chalitza ketzad? "veanta veamra", ulehallan hu omer: "veanu haleviyyim veamru". ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Rabbi yehuda omer: "veanta veamra kacha" — ad shettomar ballashon hazze.

Berachot ukelalot ketzad? kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden uvau el har gerizim veel har eval shebbeshomron, shebbetzad shechem, shebbeetzel elone more. shenneemar: "halo hemma beever hayyarden vegomer", ulehallan hu omer: "vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more". ma elon more haamur lehallan — shechem, af elon more haamur kan — shechem.

Shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizim veshishsha shevatim alu lerosh har eval, vehakkohanim vehaleviyyim vehaaron omdim lematta baemtza. hakkohanim makkifin et haaron, vehaleviyyim et hakkohanim, vechol yisrael mikkan umikkan, shenneemar: "vechol yisrael uzekenav veshotrim veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron vegomer".

Hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha: "baruch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha", veellu vaellu onin "amen". hafchu penehem kelappe har eval ufatchu biklala: "arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha", veellu vaellu onin "amen", ad sheggomrin berachot ukelalot.
Veachar kach heviu et haavanim, uvanu et hammizbeach, vesaduhu besid, vechatvu alav et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon. shenneemar: "baer hetev". venatlu et haavanim, uvau
b: Velanu bimkoman.
Gemara parashat sota menalan? — dichtiv: "veamar hakkohen laishsha" — bechol lashon shehu omer.
Tanu rabbanan: mashmiin otah bechol lashon shehi shomaat, al ma hi shota, uvamma hi shota. al ma nitmet, uvamma hi nitmet.
Al ma hi shota — al iske kinnuy usetira, uvamma hi shota — bimkidda shel cheres.
Al ma nitmet — al iske sechok veyaldut. uvamma hi nitmet — beshogeg o bemezid, beones [o] beratzon. vechol kach lamma — shello lehotzi laaz al mayim hammarim.
Vidduy maaser menalan? dichtiv: "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit", veyalef amira missota — bechol lashon shehu omer.
Amar leh rav zevid leabbaye, velelaf amira milleviyyim: ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh!
Danin "amira" geredta meamira" geredta, veen danin "amira" geredta, meaniyyay" vaamira".
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: adam omer shivcho bekol namuch ugenuto bekol ram.
Shivcho bekol namuch — min vidduy hammaaser. genuto bekol ram — mimmikra bikkurim.

Ugenuto bekol ram?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma tikkenu tefilla belachash, kede shello levayyesh et ovre avera. shehare lo chalak hakkatuv makom ben chattat leola!

La tema genuto, ella ema tzaaro. kidtanya: "vetame tame yikra" — tzarich lehodia tzaaro larabbim, verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim. vechol mi sheera bo davar tzarich lehodia larabbim, verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim.
Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma tikkenu tefilla belachash — shello levayyesh et ovre avera. shehare lo chalak hakkatuv makom ben chattat leola.
Vela? veha ikka damim: dam chattat lemala, vedam ola lematta! hatam kohen hu deyada.
Vehaikka: chattat nekeva, ola zachar! hatam mikkasseya bealya.
Tinach kivsa, seira may ikka lememar? hatam ihu deka maychsef nafsheh, deibbei leh leetoye kivsa veka mayyte seira.
Chattat daavoda zara dela saggi delav seira, may ikka lememar? hatam, nikkesif venezil ki hechi denikkappar leh.
Keriyyat shema menalan? dichtiv "shema yisrael", bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Tanu rabbanan: keriyyat shema kichtavah, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: bechol lashon.
May tama derabbi? amar kera: "vehayu" — bahavoyaytan yehu.
Verabbanan? amar kera "shema", bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Verabbanan name, ha ketiv "vehayu"! hahu shello yikraenna lemafrea.
Verabbi, shello yikraenna lemafrea menaleh? nafka la middevarim" "haddevarim". verabbanan, "devarim" "haddevarim" la mashma lehu.
Verabbi name, hachtiv "shema"! hahu mibbee leh: lehashemia leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. verabbanan savri la keman deamar: hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno — yatza.
Lema kasavar rabbi

a: Kol hattora bechol lashon neemra, dei salka datach bilshon hakkodesh neemra, "vehayu" dichtav rachamana, lema li?
Itzterich, mishshum dichtiv "shema".
Lema kasavri rabbanan kol hattora kullah bilshon kodesh neemra, dei salka datach bechol lashon — "shema" dichtav rachamana lema li?
Itzterich, mishshum dichtiv "vehayu".
Tefilla: rachame hi, kol hechi devae metzalle.

Utefilla bechol lashon? vehaamar rav yehuda: leolam al yishal adam tzerachav bilshon aramit, deamar rabbi yochanan: kol hashshoel tzerachav bilshon arammi — en malache hashsharet nizkakin lo, lefi sheen malache hashsharet makkirin bilshon arammi!
La kashya: ha — beyachid, ha — betzibbur.

Veen malache hashsharet makkirin bilshon arammi? vehatanya: yochanan kohen gadol shama bat kol mibbet kodesh hakkodashim shehu omer: netzachu talayya daazalu laagacha kerava leantochya. veshuv maase beshimon hatztzaddik sheshshama bat kol mibbet kodesh hakkodashim shehu omer: betelat avidta daamar sana leayytaa al hechla veneherag gaskalgas uvatlu gezerotav. vechatvu otah shaa, vechivvevnu. uvelashon arammi haya omer!
I baet ema: bat kol shane, dilashmoe avida. vei baet ema: gavriel hava. deamar mar: ba gavriel velimmedo shivim lashon.
Birkat hammazon — dichtiv: "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha" — bechol lashon sheatta mevarech.
Shevuat haedut — dichtiv: "venefesh ki techeta veshama kol ala" — bechol lashon shehi shomaat.
Shevuat happikkadon — atya "techta" "techta" mishshevuat haedut.

Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh: mikra bikkurim vachalitza kulei, ad mikra bikkurim ketzad "veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha", ulehallan hu omer "veanu haleviyyim veamru el kol ish yisrael", ma "aniyyay" haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Uleviyyim gufayyhu menalan? atya "kol" "kol" mimmoshe. ketiv hacha "kol ram", uchetiv hatam: "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol", ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Chalitza ketzad vechulei. verabbanan, hay "kacha" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu, ledavar shehu maase meakkev.
Verabbi yehuda mikko", "kacha". verabbanan, "ko" "kacha" la mashma lehu.
b: Verabbi yehuda, hay "veanta veamra", may aved leh? mibbee leh leagmore lilviyyim, devilshon hakkodesh.
Velelaf "kol" mimmoshe? "aniyyay" "aniyyay" gemir, "kol" "kol" la gemir.
Tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer: kol makom shenneemar "ko", "kacha", "aniyyay", vaamira" — eno ella leshon hakkodesh. "ko" — "ko tevarchu". "kacha" dachalitza. "aniyyay" vaamira" dilviyyim.

Berachot ukelalot ketzad? kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden kulei. tanu rabbanan: "halo hemma beever hayyarden", meever layyarden veelach, divre rabbi yehuda. "achare derech mevo hashshemesh" — mekom shechamma zorachat.

"Beeretz hakkenaani hayyoshev baarava" — ellu har gerizim vehar eval, sheyyoshvin bahem kutiyyim. "mul haggilgal" — samuch laggilgal, "etzel elone more" — shechem. ulehallan hu omer: "vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more", ma elon more haamur lehallan — shechem, af kan — shechem.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: bedavar ze ziyyayfti sifre chutiyyim. amarti lahem: ziyyayftem toratchem, velo heelitem beyedchem kelum. sheattem omrim elone more shechem, af anu modim sheelone more shechem. anu lemadnuha bigzera shava, attem bamme lemadtevm?
Rabbi elazar amar: "halo hemma beever hayyarden" — samuch layyarden, dei meever hayyarden veelach, halo ketiv: "vehaya beovrechem et hayyarden".
"Achare derech mevo hashshemesh" — makom shehachamma shokaat. "beeretz hakkenaani", eretz chivvi hi!
"Hayyoshev baarava" — vahalo ben harim ugevaot hen yoshvin! "mul haggilgal" — vahalo lo rau et haggilgal!

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella lehareot lahen derech bashsheniyya kederech shehera lahen barishona. "derech" — badderech lechu, velo besadot ucheramim. "hayyoshev" — bayyishshuv lechu, velo bemidbarot. "baarava" — baarava lechu, velo beharim ugevaot.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad avru yisrael et hayyarden? bechol yom aron nosea achar shene degalim, vehayyom nasa techilla, shenneemar: "hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz over lifnechem". bechol yom vayom leviyyim nosin et haaron, vehayyom nesauhu kohanim, shenneemar: "vehaya kenoach kappot ragle hakkohanim nose aron Adonai vegomer".
Tanya, rabbi yose omer: bishlosha mekomot nasu kohanim et haaron: kesheavru et hayyarden, ucheshehesebbu et yericho, ucheshehechziruhu limkomo.

a: Vechevan shennitbelu ragle chohanim bammayim, chazru hammayim laachorehem, shenneemar: "uchevo nose haaron ad hayyarden vegomer vayyaamdu hammayim hayyordim milmala kamu ned echad". vechamma govhan shel mayim — shenem asar mil al shenem asar mil, keneged machane yisrael. divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: lidvarecha, adam kal, o mayim kallim? heve omer: mayim kallim. im ken, bain mayim veshotfin otan!

Ella melammed shehayu mayim nigdashin veolin kippin al gabbe kippin, yater mishshelosh meot mil, ad sherau otan kol malche mizrach umaarav, shenneemar: "vayhi chishmoa kol malche haemori asher beever hayyarden yamma vechol malche hakkenaani asher al hayyam et asher hovish Adonai et me hayyarden mippene vene yisrael ad ovram vayyimmas levavam velo haya vam od ruach mippene bene yisrael".
Veaf rachav hazzona amra lishluche yehoshua "ki shamanu et asher hovish Adonai et me yam suf vegomer", uchetiv: "vannishma vayyimmas levavenu velo kama od vegomer".

Odam bayyarden amar lahem yehoshua: deu al ma attem ovrim et hayyarden — al menat shettorishu et yoshve haaretz mippenechem, shenneemar: "vehorashtem et kol yoshve haaretz mippenechem vegomer". im attem osin ken — mutav. veim lav, bain mayim veshotfin otichem. may "otichem" — oti veetchem.

Odam bayyarden amar lahen yehoshua: "harimu lachem ish even achat al shichmo lemispar shivte yisrael vegomer", uchetiv: "lemaan tihye zot ot bekirbechem ki yishalun benechem machar lemor ma haavanim haelle lachem vegomer", siman labbanim sheavru avot et hayyarden.

Odam bayyarden amar lahen yehoshua: "seu lachem mizze mittoch hayyarden mimmatztzav ragle hakkohanim hachin shetem esre avanim vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon asher talinu vo hallayla vegomer". yachol bechol malon umalon — talmud lomar: "asher talinu vo hallayla".

Amar rabbi yehuda: abba chalafta verabbi eliezer ben matya vachananya ben chachinay amdu al otan avanim, veshiarum kol achat veachat shekula kearbaim sea. ugemiri dituna demadle inish lechatpeh — tilta dituneh have.
Mikkan atta mechashshev laeshkol, shenneemar: "vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim". mimmashma shenneemar "bammot", eni yodea shebbishnayim? ma talmud lomar "bishnayim" — bishne motot.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: turetane, veturetane deturetane, ha ketzad? shemona nasu eshkol, echad nasa rimmon, veechad nasa teena. yehoshua vechalev lo nasu kelum. i baet ema mishshum dachashivi. vei baet ema shello hayu beotah etza.
Peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha. chad amar: ledivre rabbi yehuda —
b: Kachaniyyaytan avru. ledivre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon — beze achar ze avru.
Vechad amar: ben mar uven mar kachaniyyaytan avru. mar savar: adam kal, umar savar: mayim kallim.

"Shelach lecha anashim", amar resh lakish: "shelach lecha" — middatecha. vechi adam ze borer chelek ra leatzmo? vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyitav beenay haddavar". amar resh lakish: "beenay", velo beenav shel makom.

"Veyachperu lanu et haaretz", amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: meraggelim lo nitkavvevnu ella levoshtah shel eretz yisrael. ketiv hacha: "veyachperu lanu et haaretz", uchetiv hatam: "vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma vegomer".

"Veelle shemotam lematte reuven shammua ben zakkur", amar rabbi yitzchak: davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: meraggelim al shem maasehem nikreu. veanu lo alta beyadenu ella echad: "setur ben michael", "setur" — shessatar maasav shel hakkadosh baruch hu. "michael" — sheasa atzmo mach.
Amar rabbi yochanan, af anu nomar: "nachbi ben vofsi", "nachbi" — shehechbi devarav shel hakkadosh baruch hu. "vofsi" — sheppissa al middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

"Vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron" — "vayyavou" mibbee leh? amar rava: melammed shepperash kalev meatzat meraggelim, vehalach venishtattach al kivre avot. amar lahen: avotay! bikkeshu alay rachamim sheennatzel meatzat meraggelim.

Yehoshua kevar bikkesh moshe alav rachamim, shenneemar: "vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua", yah yoshiacha meatzat meraggelim. vehayeynu dichtiv: "veavdi chalev ekev hayta ruach acheret immo vegomer".
"Vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay vegomer", "achiman" — meyumman shebbeechav, "sheshay" — shemmesim et haaretz kishchitot, "talmay" — shemmesim et haaretz telamim telamim.
Davar acher: achiman bana anat, sheshay bana alush, talmay bana talbush. "yelide haanak" — shemmaanikin chamma bekomatan.
"Vechevron sheva shanim nivneta". may "nivneta"? ilema nivneta mammash, efshar adam bone bayit livno katan kodem livno gadol?! dichtiv: "uvene cham kush umitzrayim vegomer".

Ella shehayta mevunna al echad mishshiva betzoan. veen lecha terashim bechol eretz yisrael yater mechevron, mishshum dekavri bah shaychve. veen lecha meulla bechol haaratzot yater meeretz mitzrayim, shenneemar: "kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim", veen lecha meulla bechol eretz mitzrayim yater mitztzoan, dichtiv: "ki hayu vetzoan sarav", vaafillu hachi chevron mevunna echad mishshiva betzoan.

Vechevron terashim havay? veha ketiv: "vayhi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vegomer", veamar rav avya veittema rabba bar bar chanan: shehalach lehavi kevasim mechevron. vetanya, elim mimmoav, kevasim mechevron! minna, ayyeyde diklisha ara, avda riya veshammin kinyayna.
"Vayyashuvu mittur haaretz

a: Vayyelchu vayyavou". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: makkesh halicha levia, ma bia — beetza raa, af halicha — beetza raa.

"Vaysapperu lo vayyomru banu vegomer", uchetiv: "efes ki az haam", amar rabbi yochanan (siman emet levaddo leviyya) mishshum rabbi meir: kol lashon hara sheen bo devar emet bitchillato — en mitkayyem besofo.
"Vayyahas kalev et haam el moshe", amar rabba: shehissitan bidvarim.
Patach yehoshua, deka mishtae amri leh: den resh ketia yemallel?
Amar: i mishtaena — amri bi milleta vechasmin li. amar lahen: vechi zo bilvad asa lanu ben amram? savri bignuteh ka mishtae, ishtiku.
Amar lehu: hotzianu mimmitzrayim, vekara lanu et hayyam, veheechilanu et hamman. im yomar "asu sullamot vaalu larakia" lo nishma lo? "alo naale veyarashnu otah vegomer".

"Vehaanashim asher alu immo amru lo nuchal vegomer". amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa. "ki chazak hu mimmennu", al tikre "mimmennu", ella "mimmeno" — kivyachol afillu baal habbayit eno yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham.

"Eretz ochelet yoshveha hi", daresh rava, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani chashavtiha letova, vehem chashvu leraa. ani chashavtiha letova — dechol hecha dimto, mit chashiva didhu ki hechi denittardu vela leshaalu abbatrayyhu. veikka deamri: iyyov nach nafsheh, veitteridu kulle alma behespeda, hem chashvu leraa, "eretz ochelet yoshveha hi".
"Vannehi veenenu kachagavim vechen hayinu vegomer", amar rav mesharsheya: meraggelim shakkare havo, bishlama "vannehi beenenu kachagavim" — lechayye, ella "vechen hayinu beenehem", mena havo yadi?
Vela hi, ki havo mavri avele — tute arze havo mavri, vechi chazinhu, seliku yatvi beilane, shami dekaamri: kachazenan inashe dedamu lekamtze beilane.

"Vattissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam vayyivku", amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: oto hayyom erev tisha beav haya, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hen bachu bechiyya shel chinnam vaani ekba lahem bechiyya ledorot.
"Vayyomru kol haeda lirgom otam baavanim", uchetiv: "vechavod Adonai nira beohel moed", amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: melammed shennatlu avanim uzerakum kelappe mala.

"Vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa", amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shemmetu mita meshunna. amar rabbi chanina bar pappa, daresh rabbi shela ish kefar temarta: melammed shennishtarbev leshonam venafal al tibburam, vehayu tolaim yotzot milleshonam venichnasot betibburam, umittibburam venichnasot bilshonam. verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: beaskara metu.

Vechevan sheala haacharon shebbeyisrael min hayyarden chazru mayim limkoman, shenneemar: "vayhi baalot hakkohanim nose aron berit Adonai mittoch hayyarden nitteku kappot ragle hakkohanim el hecharava vayyashuvu me hayyarden limkomam vayyelchu chitmol shilshom al kol gedotav",
Nimtza aron venosav vechohanim mitztzad echad, veyisrael mitztzad echad. nasa aron et nosav veavar, shenneemar: "vayhi kaasher tam kol haam laavor vayyaavor aron Adonai vehakkohanim lifne haam".
Veal davar ze neenash uzza, shenneemar: "vayyavou ad goren kidon vayyishlach uzza et yado leechoz et haaron", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: uzza, nosav nasa, atzmo lo kol shekken!
"Vayyichar af Adonai beuzza vayyakkehu sham al hashshal vegomer". rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: al iske shalu. vechad amar: sheasa tzerachav befanav.
"Vayyamot sham im aron haelohim", amar rabbi yochanan: uzza ba laolam habba, shenneemar: "im aron haelohim" — ma aron leolam kayyaym, af uzza ba laolam habba.
"Vayyichar ledavid al asher paratz Adonai peretz beuzza", amar rabbi elazar: shennishtannu panav kacharara.
Ella meatta kol hecha dichtiv "vayyichar", hachi name?! hatam ketiv "af", hacha la ketiv "af".
Daresh rava: mippene ma neenash david — mippene shekkara ledivre tora "zemirot", shenneemar: "zemirot hayu li chukkecha bevet meguray".

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: divre tora shekkatuv bahen "hataif enecha bo veenennu", atta kore otan zemirot?! hareni machshilcha bedavar sheafillu tinokot shel bet rabban yodin oto, dichtiv: "velivne kehat lo natan ki avodat hakkodesh vegomer", veihu atyeh baagalta.
"Vayyach beanshe vet shemesh ki rau baaron", mishshum derau "vayyach" elohim? rabbi avahu verabbi elazar, chad amar: kotzrin umishtachavim hayu, vechad amar: mille name amur.
b: Man amreyach (leha) deimmarayyt uman ata alach deippayyayst.

"Vayyach baam shivim ish chamishshim elef ish", rabbi avahu verabbi elazar, chad amar: shivim ish hayu, vechol echad veechad shakul kachamishshim elef. vechad amar: chamishshim elef hayu, vechol echad veechad shakul keshivim sanhedrin.

"Vayhi ki tzaadu nose aron Adonai shishsha tzeadim vayyizbach shor umeri", uchetiv "shiva farim veshiva elim". amar rav pappa bar shemuel: al kol pesia ufesia shor umeri, al kol shesh veshesh pesiot shiva farim veshiva elim.
Amar leh rav chisda: im ken, milleta et kol eretz yisrael bamot! ella amar rav chisda: al kol shesh veshesh pesiot — shor umeri, al kol shishsha sedarim shel shesh pesiot — shiva farim veshiva elim.
Ketiv "kidon", uchetiv "nachon". amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla kidon, ulevassof nachon.

Nimtzeta atta omer shelosha mine avanim hayu: echad shehekim moshe beeretz moav, shenneemar: "beever hayyarden beeretz moav hoil moshe beer vegomer", ulehallan hu omer: "vechatavta alehen et kol divre hattora hazzot vegomer", veatya "beer" "beer".

Veechad shehekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden, shenneemar: "ushetem esre avanim hekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden". veechad shehekim baggilgal, shenneemar: "veet shetem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu vegomer".
Tanu rabbanan: ketzad katvu yisrael et hattora? rabbi yehuda omer: al gabbe avanim ketavuha, shenneemar: "vechatavta al haavanim et kol divre hattora hazzot vegomer", veachar kach sadu otan besid.

Amar lo rabbi shimon: lidvarecha, heach lamdu ummot haolam tora? amar lo: bina yetera natan bahem hakkadosh baruch hu, veshiggeru noterin shellahen, vekillefu et hassid vehissiuha. veal davar ze nitchattem gezar dinam liver shachat, shehaya lahen lilmod velo lamdu.
Rabbi shimon omer: al gabbe sid ketavuha, vechatvu lahen lematta "yelammedu etchem laasot kechol vegomer". ha lamadta sheim hayu chozrin bitshuva — hayu mekabbelin otan.
Amar rava bar shela: may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv: "vehayu ammim misrefot sid" — al iske sid.
Verabbi yehuda: ki sid, ma sid en lo takkana ella serefa — af ummot haolam en lahem takkana ella serefa.
Keman azla ha detanya "veshavita shivyo" — lerabbot kenaanim shebbechutza laaretz, sheim chozrin bitshuva mekabbelin otan?

a: Keman — kerabbi shimon.

Bo uree kamma nissim naasu beoto hayyom: avru yisrael et hayyarden, uvau lehar gerizim ulehar eval yater mishshishshim mil, veen kol beriyya yechola laamod bifnehem, vechol haomed bifnehem miyyad nitraz, shenneemar: "et emati ashallach lefanecha vehammoti et kol haam asher tavo bahem vegomer".
Veomer "tippol alehem emata vafachad ... ad yaavor ammecha Adonai" — zo bia rishona, "ad yaavor am zu kanita" — zo bia sheniyya.
Emor meatta: reuyin hayu yisrael laasot lahem nes bevia sheniyya kevia rishona, ella sheggaram hachet.
Veachar kach heviu et haavanim, uvanu et hammizbeach, vesaduhu besid, vechatvu alehem et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon, shenneemar: "baer hetev",
Veheelu olot ushelamim, veachlu veshatu vesamchu, uverchu vekillelu, vekippelu et haavanim, uvau velanu baggilgal, shenneemar: "vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon".
Yachol bechol malon umalon — talmud lomar: "asher talinu vo hallayla", uchetiv: "veet shetem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu vegomer".
Tana: tzira lo avra immahem. vela? veha ketiv: "veshalachti et hatztzira lefanecha".

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: al sefat yarden amda, vezarka bahen mara. vesimmeta enehen millemala, vesersatan millematta, shenneemar: "veanochi hishmadti et haemori mippenehem asher kegova arazim govho vechason hu kaallonim vaashmid piryo mimmaal veshorashav mittachat vegomer".
Rav pappa amar: shete tzeraot havay, chada demoshe vachada dihoshua. demoshe la avar, dihoshua avar.
Shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizim kulei. may "vehachetzyo"? amar rav kahana: kederech shechalukin kan — kach chalukin beavne efod.

Metivi: shete avanim tovot hayu lo lechohen gadol al ketefav, achat mikkan veachat mikkan, ushemot shenem asar shevatim katuv alehem, shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo, shenneemar: "shishsha mishshemotam al haeven haechat vegomer".
Sheniyya ketoldotam, velo rishona ketoldotam — mippene sheyyehuda mukedam. vachamishshim otiyyot hayu, esrim vechamesh al even zo veesrim vechamesh al even zo.
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer:
b: Lo kederech shechalukin bechomesh happekudim, chalukin beavne efod, ella kederech shechalukin bechomesh sheni.
Ketzad? bene lea kesidran, bene rachel echad mikkan veechad mikkan, uvene shefachot baemtza.

Veella may ani mekayyem "ketoldotam" — kishmotan shekkara lahen avihen, velo keshemot shekkara lahen moshe. "reuven", velo "reuveni", "shimon", velo "shimoni", "dan" velo "haddani", "gad" velo "haggadi". teyuveta derav kahana! teyuveta.
Veella may "vehachetzyo"? tana: — chetzyo shel mul har gerizim merubbe mechetzyo shel har eval, mippene shellevi lematta.

Adderabba, mippene shellevi lematta batzri lehu! hachi kaamar: af al pi shellevi lematta — bene yosef immahem. shenneemar: "vaydabberu bene yosef et yehoshua lemor maddua natatta li nachala goral echad vechevel echad vaani am rav ... vayyomer alehem yehoshua im am rav atta ale lecha hayyara".

Amar lahen: lechu vehachebiu atzmechem bayyearim, shello tishlot bachem ayin hara. amaru leh: zareh deyosef la shalta beh ena bisha, dichtiv: "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin", veamar rabbi avahu: al tehi kore "ale ayin", ella "ole ayin".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar, mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz", ma dagim shebbayyam — mayim mechassin alehen veen haayin sholetet bahen, af zaro shel yosef — en haayin sholetet bahen.
Hane chamishshim otiyyot? chamishshim neche chada havyayn! amar rabbi yitzchak: yosef hosifu lo ot achat, shenneemar: "edut bihosef samo betzeto al eretz mitzrayim".
Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: "ketoldotam" baenan! ella: kol hattora kullah "binyamin" ketiv, vehacha "binyamin" shalem, kedichtiv: "veaviv kara lo vinyamin".

Amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: yosef shekkiddesh shem shamayim basseter — hosifu alav ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, yehuda shekkiddesh shem shamayim befarhesya — nikra kullo al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Yosef may hi — dichtiv: "vayhi kehayyom hazze vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto", amar rabbi yochanan: melammed sheshshenehem lidvar avera nitkavvevnu. "vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto". rav ushemuel, chad amar: laasot melachto mammash, vechad amar: laasot tzerachav nichnas.

"Veen ish meanshe habbayit vegomer", efshar bayit gadol keveto shel oto rasha lo haya bo ish?! tana deve rabbi yishmael: oto hayyom yom chaggam haya, vehalchu kullan levet avoda zara shellahem, vehi amra lahen chola hi, amra: en li yom shennizkak li yosef kayyom hazze.

"Vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor vegomer", beotah shaa bata deyokno shel aviv venirata lo bachallon, amar lo yosef! atidin achecha sheyyikkatvu al avne efod veatta benehem, retzoncha sheyyimmache shimcha mibbenehem, vetikkare roe zonot? dichtiv: "veroe zonot yeabbed hon".
Miyyad — "vatteshev beetan kashto", amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: sheshshava kashto leetanah. "vayyafozzu zeroe yadav" — naatz yadav bakkarka veyatza shichvat zaro mibben tzipporne yadav.
"Midde avir yaakov", mi garam lo sheyyechakek al avne efod — ella avir yaakov. "mishsham roe even yisrael", mishsham zacha venaasa roe, shenneemar: "roe yisrael haazina noheg katztzon yosef".

Tanya: haya rauy yosef latzet mimmennu shenem asar shevatim kederech sheyyatzu miyyaakov aviv, shenneemar: "elle toldot yaakov yosef", ella sheyyatza shichvat zaro mibben tzipporne yadav. veaf al pi chen, yatzu mibbinyamin achiv, vechullan nikreu al shemo, shenneemar: "uvene vinyamin bela vavecher veashbel vegomer".
"Bela" — shennivla ben haummot, "uvecher" — bechor leimmo haya, "veashbel" — sheshshevao el, "gera" — sheggar beachsanyot,

"Venaaman" — shennaim beyoter, "echi varosh" — achi hu veroshi hu, "muppim vechuppim" — hu lo raa bechuppati vaani lo raiti bechuppato, "vaard" — sheyyarad leven ummot haolam. ikka deamri: "vaard" — sheppanav domin levevred.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: beshaa sheamar lo paro leyosef "uviladecha lo yarim ish et yado vegomer", amru itztagnine faro: eved shellekacho rabbo beesrim kesef tamshilehu alenu? amar lahen: ginnune malchut ani roe bo.

Amru lo: im ken, yehe yodea beshivim lashon! ba gavriel velimmedo shivim lashon. la hava kagamar. hosif lo ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu velamad, shenneemar: "edut bihosef samo betzeto al eretz mitzrayim sefat lo yadati eshma". ulemachar, kol lishshana deishtai paro bahadeh, ahdar leh.
Ishtai ihu bilshon hakkodesh, la hava ka yada may hava amar. amar leh: agmari. agmereh vela gemar. amar leh: ishteva li dela megallet. ishteva lo.
Ki amar leh "avi hishbiani lemor", amar leh: zil itteshil ashshevuatach. amar leh: veitteshil name addidach. veaf al gav dela nicha leh, amar leh: "ale ukevor et avicha kaasher hishbiecha".
Yehuda may hi? detanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kesheamdu yisrael al hayyam hayu shevatim menatztzechim ze im ze, ze omer: ani yored techilla layyam, veze omer: ani yored techilla layyam, kafatz

a: Shivto shel binyamin veyarad layyam techilla, shenneemar: "sham binyamin tzair rodem", al tikre "rodem" ella "rad yam". vehayu sare yehuda rogmim otam, shenneemar: "sare yehuda rigmatam".
Lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushepizchan laggevura, shenneemar: "uven ketefav shachen".

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: lo kach haya maase, ella ze omer: en ani yored techilla layyam, veze omer: en ani yored techilla layyam, kafatz nachshon ben amminadav veyarad layyam techilla, shenneemar: "sevavuni vechachash efrayim uvemirma bet yisrael vihuda od rad im el".
Vealav meforash bakkabbala: "hoshieni elohim ki vau mayim ad nafesh ... tavati biven metzula veen moomad vegomer", "al tishtefeni shibbolet mayim veal tivlaeni metzula vegomer".

Beotah shaa haya moshe maarich bitfilla, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: yedidayy tovim bayyam veatta maarich bitfilla lefanay?! amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! uma beyadi laasot? amar lo: "dabber el bene yisrael veyissau. veatta harem et mattecha unete et yadcha vegomer".
Lefichach, zacha yehuda laasot memshala beyisrael, shenneemar: "hayta yehuda lekodsho yisrael mamshelotav", ma taam "hayta yehuda lekodsho veyisrael mamshelotav" — mishshum dehayyam raa vayyanos".
Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: i efshar lomar levi lematta, shekkevar neemar lemala. vei efshar lomar lemala, shekkevar neemar lematta.
Ha ketzad? zikne kehunna uleviyya lematta, vehashshear lemala. rabbi yoshiyya omer: kol harauy lesharet lematta, vehashshear lemala.
Rabbi omer: ellu veellu lematta hen omdim, hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha, kelappe har eval ufatchu biklala. may "al" — al besamuch.
Kidtanya: "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka", rabbi omer: "al" — besamuch. atta omer "al" besamuch, o eno ella al mammash? keshehu omer "vesakkota al haaron", heve omer "al" besamuch.
Hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha kulei, tanu rabbanan: "baruch" bichlal, "baruch" bifrat. "arur" bichlal, "arur" bifrat, lilmod ulelammed lishmor velaasot, hare
b: Arba, arba vearba hare shemone, shemone ushemone hare shesh esre. vechen besinay, vechen bearvot moav, shenneemar: "elle divre habberit asher tzivva Adonai et moshe vegomer, uchetiv: "ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vegomer". nimtza arbaim ushemone beritot al kol mitzva umitzva.
Rabbi shimon motzi har gerizim vehar eval, umachnis ohel moed shebbammidbar.

Uviflugeta dehane tannae detanya, rabbi yishmael omer: kelalot neemru besinay uferatot beohel moed. rabbi akiva omer: kelalot uferatot neemru besinay, venishnu beohel moed, venishtalleshu bearvot moav.
Veen lach kol devar mitzva umitzva shekketuva battora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushemone beritot.

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko amar mishshum rabbi shimon: en lecha mitzva umitzva shekketuva battora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushemone beritot shel shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim.

Amar rabbi: ledivre rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon, en lecha kol mitzva umitzva shebbattora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushemone beritot shel shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim. nimtza lechol echad veechad miyyisrael shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim.
May benayyhu? amar rav mesharsheya: arva vearva dearva ikka benayyhu.
Daresh rabbi yehuda ben nachmani meturegmaneh derabbi shimon ben lakish: kol happarasha kullah lo neemra ella benoef venoefet,
"Arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha vegomer", bearur" saggi leh? ella: ze habba al haerva veholid ben, vehalach leven ummot haolam veavad avoda zara. arurin aviv veimmo shel ze shekkach garmu lo.

Tanu rabbanan: "venatatta et habberacha al har gerizim veet hakkelala vegomer", ma talmud lomar? im lelammed shettehe beracha al har gerizim ukelala al har eval, hare kevar neemar "elle yaamdu levarech et haam al har gerizim", uchetiv "veelle yaamdu al hakkelala behar eval"! ella lehakedim beracha liklala.
Yachol yihyu kol habberachot kodmot lakkelalot, talmud lomar: "beracha" ukelala" — beracha achat kodemet liklala, veen kol habberachot kodmot lakkelalot.

Ulehakkish beracha liklala, lomar lach: ma kelala bilviyyim, af beracha bilviyyim. uma kelala bekol ram, af beracha bekol ram. uma kelala bilshon hakkodesh, af beracha bilshon hakkodesh. uma kelala bichlal uferat, af beracha bichlal uferat. uma kelala — ellu vaellu onin veomrim "amen", af beracha — ellu vaellu onin veomrim "amen".
Mishna birkat kohanim ketzad? bammedina omer otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha achat. bammikdash omer et hashshem

a: Kichtavo, uvammedina bechinnuyo. bammedina kohanim nosim et yedehen keneged kitfehen, uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen. chutz mikkohen gadol, sheeno magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer: af kohen gadol magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ko tevarchu" — bilshon hakkodesh. atta omer bilshon hakkodesh, o eno ella bechol lashon? neemar kan "ko tevarchu", veneemar lehallan "elle yaamdu levarech et haam". ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "ko" — ad sheyyomru ballashon hazze.
Tanya iddach: "ko tevarchu" — baamida. atta omer baamida, o eno ella afillu bishiva? neemar kan "ko tevarchu", veneemar lehallan "elle yaamdu levarech". ma lehallan baamida — af kan baamida.
Rabbi natan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "lesharto ulevarech bishmo". ma mesharet baamida, af mevarech baamida. umesharet gufeh menalan — dichtiv: "laamod lesharet".

Tanya iddach: "ko tevarchu" — binsiut kappayim. atta omer binsiut kappayim, o eno ella shello binsiut kappayim? neemar kan "ko tevarchu", veneemar lehallan "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem". ma lehallan binsiut kappayim — af kan binsiut kappayim.
Kashya leh lerabbi yonatan: i ma lehallan kohen gadol verosh chodesh vaavodat tzibbur, af kan kohen gadol verosh chodesh vaavodat tzibbur?
Rabbi natan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "hu uvanav kol hayyamim", makkish banav lo: ma hu binsiut kappayim — af banav binsiut kappayim. uchetiv: "kol hayyamim". veittakkash beracha lesherut.
Vetanya iddach: "ko tevarchu et bene yisrael" — bashshem hameforash. atta omer bashshem hameforash, o eno ella bechinnuy? talmud lomar: "vesamu et shemi" — shemi hameyuchad li.
Yachol af baggevulin ken — neemar kan "vesamu et shemi", veneemar lehallan "lasum et shemo sham". ma lehallan — bet habbechira, af kan bevet habbechira.

Rabbi yoshiyya omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha". bechol makom salka datach? ella mikra ze mesoras hu: bechol makom asher avo elecha uverachticha — sham azkir et shemi. vehechan avo elecha uverachticha — bevet habbechira, sham azkir et shemi — bevet habbechira.
Tanya iddach: "ko tevarchu et bene yisrael", en li ella bene yisrael. gerim, nashim, vaavadim meshucherarim, minnayin? talmud lomar: "amor lahem", lechullehu.
Tanya iddach: "ko tevarchu" — panim keneged panim. atta omer panim keneged panim, o eno ella panim keneged oref? talmud lomar: "amor lahem", keadam haomer lachavero.
Tanya iddach: "ko tevarchu" — bekol ram. o eno ella belachash? talmud lomar: "amor lahem" — keadam sheomer lachavero.

Amar abbaye: naktinan, lishnayim kore "kohanim", uleechad eno kore "kohen", shenneemar: "amor lahem" — lishnayim. veamar rav chisda: naktinan, kohen kore "kohanim", veen yisrael kore "kohanim", shenneemar: "amor lahem", amira
b: Mishshellahem tehe. vehilcheta kevoteh deabbaye, velet hilcheta kevoteh derav chisda.
(Siman: mitavve livracha duchan baavoda kos makkir nehene beegla).

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mitavve levirkat kohanim — shenneemar: "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarchem". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen shemmevarech — mitbarech, vesheeno mevarech — en mitbarech, shenneemar: "vaavarcha mevarchecha".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan — over bishlosha ase: "ko tevarchu", "amor lahem", "vesamu et shemi".
Rav amar: choshshin shemma ben gerusha o ben chalutza hu.
Vela peligi, ha — desalek lifrakim, ha — dela salek lifrakim.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen sheeno ole baavoda, shuv eno ole, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim", ma lehallan — baavoda, af kan — baavoda.
