Ini? veha rabbi amme verabbi assi salki! rabbi amme verabbi assi meikkara havo akri karayyhu, mimta la hava matu hatam. vechidtane rabbi oshaya: lo shanu, ella shello akar et raglav, aval akar et raglav — ole.
Utenan name — im havetachato shennose et kappav vechozer litfillato — rashshay. vehavenan ba: ha la akar? ella denad pureta, hacha name deakar pureta.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en notnin kos shel beracha levarech ella letov ayin, shenneemar: "tov ayin hu yevorach ki natan millachmo laddal", al tikre "yevorach" ella "yevarech".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin sheafillu ofot makkirin betzare haayin — shenneemar: "ki chinnam mezora harashet beene kol baal kanaf".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hannehene mitztzare haayin over belav — shenneemar: "al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vegomer ki kemo shaar benafsho ken hu echol ushete yomar lach vegomer". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: over bishne lavin, "al tilcham", "veal titav".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en egla arufa baa ella bishvil tzare haayin,

Shenneemar: "veanu veamru yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze". vechi al libbenu alta shezzikne bet din shofche damim hem? ella, lo ba leyadenu ufetarnuhu, velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu. lo ba leyadenu ufetarnuhu belo mezonot, lo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu belo levayay.
Amar adda amar rabbi simlay: bet hakkeneset shekkullah kohanim — kullan olin ladduchan. lemi mevarchin? amar rabbi zera: laachehem shebbassadot.
Ini? vehatane abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyyay: am sheachore kohanim enan bichlal beracha! la kashya, ha — daanisi, ha — dela anisi.
Vehatane rav shimi mibbirta deshichori: bet hakkeneset shekkullah kohanim — miktzatan olin, umiktzatan onin "amen"!
La kashya: ha — deishteyuyr be asara, ha — dela ishteyuyr be asra.
Gufa, tana abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyyay: am sheachore kohanim enan bichlal beracha.
Peshita, ariche beappe gutze la mafseki. teva — la mafseka. mechitza may? ta shema, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: afillu mechitza shel barzel enah mafseket ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
Ibbaya lehu: tzedadin mahu? amar abba mar bar rav ashe: ta shema, ditnan: nitkavvevn lehazzot lefanav

a: Vehizza leacharav, leacharav vehizza lefanav — hazzaato pesula. lefanav vehizza al tzedadin shebbefanav — hazzaato keshera.

Amar rava bar rav huna: kevan shenniftach sefer tora asur lesapper afillu bidvar halacha, shenneemar: "uvefitcho amdu kol haam", veen amida ella shetika, shenneemar: "vehochalti ki lo yedabberu ki amdu lo anu od". rabbi zera amar rav chisda, mehacha: "veozne chol haam el sefer hattora".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen shello natal yadav — lo yissa et kappav, shenneemar: "seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai".
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ben shammua: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahen: miyyamay lo asiti bet hakkeneset kappendarya, velo pasati al rashe am kodesh, velo nasati kappay belo beracha.
May mevarech? amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: "asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava".

Ki akar kareh may amar? yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettehe beracha zo shetztzivvitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael, lo yehe bah michshol veavon. vechi mahdar appeh mitztzibbura may amar? adbereh rav chisda lerav ukeva uderash: "ribbono shel olam asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu
b: Ma shehivtachtanu. hashekifa mimmeon kodshecha min hashshamayim vegomer".

Amar rav chisda: en hakkohanim rashshaim lachof kishre etzbeotehen ad sheyyachziru penehem min hatztzibbur. amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hakkore rashshay likrot "kohanim" ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur,

Veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil bivracha ad sheyyichle dibbur mippi hakkore, veen hatztzibbur rashshain laanot "amen" ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkohanim, veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur.

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hakkohanim rashshain lehachezir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur besim shalom", veenan rashshain laakor raglehem velelech ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur "sim shalom".

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: en hatztzibbur rashshain laanot "amen" ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkore, veen hakkore rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi hatztzibbur, veen hametargem rashshay lehatechil battargum ad sheyyichle pasuk mippi hakkore, veen hakkore rashshay lehatechil befasuk acher ad sheyyichle targum mippi hametargem.

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammaftir benavi, tzarich sheyyikra battora techilla, veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en hammaftir rashshay lehafetir bannavi ad sheyyiggalel sefer tora.
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en sheliach tzibbur rashshay lehafeshit et hatteva batztzibbur, mippene kevod tzibbur.
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en hatztzibbur rashshain latzet, ad sheyyinnatel sefer tora veyanuyach bimkomo. ushemuel amar: ad sheyyetze.
Vela peligi: ha — deikka pitcha acharina. ha — delekka pitcha acharina. amar rava, bar ahina asbera li: "achare Adonai elohechem telechu".

Bizman shehakkohanim mevarchim et haam, ma hen omrim? amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda: "barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach vegomer", "barchu Adonai kol tzevaav meshartav ose retzono", "barchu Adonai kol maasav bechol mekomot memshalto barchi nafshi et Adonai".

Bemusefe deshabbeta, ma hen omrim? amar rabbi assi: "shir hammaalot hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai", "baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam haleluyah".

Velema name "yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon", dichtiv behahu inyayna! amar yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: mittoch shehitchil bevirchotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu mesayyem bevirchotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Beminchata detaanita may amri? amar rav acha bar yaakov: "im avonenu anu vanu Adonai ase lemaan shemecha", "mikve yisrael moshio beet tzara lamma tihye keger baaretz vegomer", "lamma tihye keish nidham kegibbor lo yuchal lehoshia vegomer".

a: Binila deyoma dechippure may amar? amar mar zutera, veamri la bematnita: "hinne chi chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai". "yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalam kol yeme chayyecha". "uree vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael".
Hechan omran? rav yosef amar: ben kol beracha uveracha, verav sheshet amar: behazekarat hashshem.
Peligi ba rav mari verav zevid. chad amar: pesuka lokovel pesuka, vechad amar: akkol pesuka amar lehu lechullehu.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: kol haomran baggevulin — eno ella toe. amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: tidda divmikdash name la mibbee lememrinhu, kelum yesh lecha eved shemmevarchin oto veeno maazin?

Amar rabbi acha bar chanina: teda devigvulin name mibbee lememrinhu, kelum yesh eved shemmevarchin oto veen masbir panim? amar rabbi avahu: meresh hava amena lehu, kevan dachazena leh lerabbi abba demin akko dela amar lehu — ana name la amena lehu.
Veamar rabbi avahu: meresh hava amena invetana ana. kevan dachazena leh lerabbi abba demin akko deamar ihu chad tama veamar amoreh chad tama vela kafed — amena lav invetana ana.

Umay invevtanuteh derabbi avahu? daamara la devethu deamoreh derabbi avahu lidveteh derabbi avahu: ha didan la tzerich leh ledidach, vehay degachen vezakef aleh — yekara bealma hu deaved leh. azala devethu vaamara leh lerabbi avahu. amar la: umay nafka lich minna? minni uminneh yitkallas illaa.
Vetu, rabbi avahu immeno rabbanan aleh lemimneyeh beresha, kevan dechazye lerabbi abba demin akko dinfishi leh baale chovot, amar lehu: ikka rabba.

Rabbi avahu verabbi chiyyay bar abba ikkelau lehahu atra, rabbi avahu derash beaggadta, rabbi chiyyay bar abba derash bishmata. shavku kulle alma lerabbi chiyyay bar abba, vaazul legabbeh derabbi avahu. chalash dateh. amar leh: emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome: lishne bene adam, echad mocher avanim tovot veechad mocher mine sidkit, al mi koftzin — lo al ze shemmocher mine sidkit?

Kol yoma: hava malve rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi avahu ad ushepizeh mishshum yekara deve kesar. hahu yoma alveye rabbi avahu lerabbi chiyyay bar abba ad ushepizeh, vaafillu hachi la ittotav dateh minneh.

Bizman sheshsheliach tzibbur omer modim, haam ma hem omrim? amar rav: "modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu al sheanu modim lach". ushemuel amar: "elohe kol basar, al sheanu modim lach". rabbi simay omer: "yotzrenu yotzer bereshit al sheanu modim lach". nehardae amri mishshemeh derabbi simay: "berachot vehodaot leshimcha haggadol al shehecheyitanu vekiyyaymtanu, al sheanu modim lach". rav acha bar yaakov mesayyem ba hachi: "ken techayyenu utechonnenu, utekabbetzenu, veteesof galiyyotenu lechatzrot kodshecha, lishmor chukkecha velaasot retzoncha belevav shalem, al sheanu modim lach".
Amar rav pappa: hilkach nemrinhu lechullehu.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: leolam tehe emat tzibbur alecha, shehare kohanim penehem kelappe haam vaachorehem kelappe shechina.

Rav nachman amar: mehacha: "vayyakom david hammelech al raglav vayyomer shemauni achay veammi". im "achay" lamma "ammi", veim "ammi" lamma "achay"? amar rabbi elazar: amar lahem david leyisrael: im attem, shomin li — achay attem, veim lav — ammi attem, vaani rode etchem bemakkel.

Rabbanan amri mehacha: deen hakkohanim rashshain laalot besandelehen ladduchan. vezehu achat mittesha takkanot shehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay. may tama — lav mishshum kevod tzibbur? amar rav ashe: la, hatam shemma nifseka lo retzua besandalo vahadar azel lemiktereh, veamri: ben gerusha o ben chalutza hu.
Uvemikdash beracha achat kulei.
b: Vechol kach lamma — lefi sheen onin "amen" bammikdash.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen onin "amen" bammikdash — shenneemar: "kumu barchu et Adonai elohechem min haolam ad haolam". uminnayin sheal kol beracha uveracha tehilla — shenneemar: "vivarchu shem kevodecha umeromam al kol beracha utehilla". al kol beracha uveracha ten lo tehilla.
Mishna birchot kohen gadol ketzad? chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lo lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol,

Vechohen gadol omed umekabbel, vekore "achare mot", veach beasor". vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko, veomer: yater mimma shekkariti lifnechem katuv kan. "uveasor" shebbechomesh happekudim kore al pe.
Umevarech aleha shemone berachot: al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodayay, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash, veal yisrael, veal hakkohanim, veal yerushalayim, vehashshear tefilla.
Gemara shamat minna cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav.
Amar abbaye: kulla mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol hu.

Vechohen gadol omed umekabbel vekore vechulei. "omed" — mikkelal deyoshev hu? vehaamar mar: en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad, shenneemar: "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai vayyomer mi anochi vegomer"!
Kidamar rav chisda: beezrat nashim, hacha name beezrat nashim.
Metivi: vehechan korin bo — baazara, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behar habbayit, shenneemar:
